Steady.en: You can give plans time to take shape.
Steady.hi: योजनाओं को आकार लेने का समय दे सकते हैं।

Supportive.en: Two plans may be moving toward a useful meeting point.
Supportive.hi: दो योजनाओं में तालमेल बन सकता है।

Take care.en: You can leave room to revise your plans.
Take care.hi: योजनाओं में बदलाव की गुंजाइश रख सकते हैं।

vedic/annual-chart/conventions.yaml.muntha: (zero-based natal rising sign + completed solar returns) modulo twelve; bind the sign ruler.
panchadhikari: annual Sun sign ruler by day or Moon sign ruler by night
annual rising sign triplicity ruler for return sect
vedic/annual-chart/conventions.yaml.selection: Deduplicate candidates; retain those aspecting the annual ascendant by Tajika sign aspect (including occupation). Select highest Panchavargiya; tie or missing strength is unresolved. If none aspects, take Muntha ruler as labelled fallback.

sources.other_locator: Samjna Tantra, aspects and sixteen yogas; Varsha Tantra, year lord
sources.supports: Traditional calculation or classification. Reflective wording is editorial.

vedic/annual-chart/conventions.yaml.traditions_differ: Some schools prioritize friendly aspects or the sect luminary ruler in an inconclusive election. Select one convention throughout.
vedic/annual-chart/conventions.yaml.year_tone: Independent annual section. Supporting application alone may contribute Supportive, obstructed application alone Take care; absent, mixed or unresolved testimonies Steady. No natal card or grade change.

duphali-kuttha.formation: A capable slower recipient receives an application from a less dignified but unimpaired faster body.

durapha.formation: The bound significator lacks dignity and is impeded by affliction or combustion.

dutthottha-davira.formation: An otherwise impaired pair receives material assistance through a dignified third planet.

gairi-kamboola.formation: A Moon late in its sign enters the next sign and joins a competent significator in application.

ikkabala.formation: All seven classical planets occupy angular or succedent houses.

ishrafa.formation: The in-orb contact has passed perfection and the gap is opening.

ithasala.formation: A significator closes on a permitted aspect within the mean orb.

kamboola.formation: Moon joins an application of the two significators by applying to either.

khallasara.formation: Significators apply but Moon neither connects with them nor conveys light.

kuttha.formation: The bound significator is dignified and free of combustion, retrogression and hostile affliction.

manau.formation: Mars or Saturn afflicts the faster significator before its applying contact perfects.

nakta.formation: A faster intermediary transfers light between otherwise disconnected principals.

radda.formation: An application is frustrated by a debilitated, combust or retrograding recipient.

tambira.formation: A late-degree faster planet enters the following sign and then applies to a dignified receiver.

yamaya.formation: Both disconnected principals apply to the same slower collector.

vedic/annual-chart/periods.yaml.interval: UTC half-open; clip at next return. Never borrow natal year_days.

mudda.method: Advance natal star lord by completed years modulo nine. Each major spans its Vimshottari years times three days. Elapsed fraction of birth star sets the first balance; wrap to obtain a complete annual schedule.

patyayini.method: Include seven classical planets and ascendant. Sort by degrees within sign (krishamsha); first patyamsha equals first value, following shares are successive differences. Normalize by largest value to the labelled year. Equal positions give zero second share in stable body order, all zero withholds.

sources.other_locator: Samjna Tantra, aspects and sixteen yogas; Varsha Tantra, year lord
sources.supports: Traditional calculation or classification. Reflective wording is editorial.

vedic/annual-chart/periods.yaml.traditions_differ: A measured return-to-return year can replace the conventional annual clock only in a labelled variant.

vedic/annual-chart/sahams.yaml.locator: Rao, Integrated Approach, annual lots; secondary comparison PyJHora 5.0.6 transit/saham.py named functions, Punya through Vanik. Classical edition locator pending.
vedic/annual-chart/sahams.yaml.method: Normalize A minus B plus C. Add 30 degrees if C is outside the inclusive forward arc B to A. Normalize again.
vedic/annual-chart/sahams.yaml.night: Reverse first two operands. Resolve Punya first in the same sect.

sources.other_locator: Samjna Tantra, aspects and sixteen yogas; Varsha Tantra, year lord
sources.supports: Traditional calculation or classification. Reflective wording is editorial.

vedic/annual-chart/sahams.yaml.traditions_differ: Uncorrected lots and sign-only inclusion are alternatives. Karya here means Karma (work), distinct from Karyasiddhi.

harsha.awards: Five each for favourite house, own or exalted sign, group-appropriate house, matching return sect. No rounding.

panchavargiya.decan: Use classical D3 sign lord; labelled variant uses Chaldean faces.
panchavargiya.decan_method: First, fifth and ninth signs from the sign occupied in successive ten-degree intervals; harmonic ninth for navamsha.
panchavargiya.method: For each non-exaltation component assess the host against the planet by annual Tajika sign relations (3/5/9/11 friendly, 1/4/7/10 hostile, others neutral). Own host takes precedence. Exaltation units = 20 times shortest arc from deep fall divided by 180. Divide sum by four.

vedic/dashas/narayana/periods.yaml.clock_policy: Use one fixed year length from the KB-14 clock throughout each tree. The system-specific default for the existing dated reference is 365.2425 days and the savana variant is 360. Use exact UTC offsets from the full parent start and half-open boundaries.
vedic/dashas/narayana/periods.yaml.clock_reason: Preserve this system’s dated references independently of the Vimshottari default.
vedic/dashas/narayana/periods.yaml.complement_convention: Cap the first pass at twelve before computing its complement. This handles a ruler simultaneously in its own and exaltation sign.
vedic/dashas/narayana/periods.yaml.dual_lords: Scorpio uses Mars/Ketu and Aquarius Saturn/Rahu. If just one occupies the owned sign use the other. If both occupy it use the classical ruler. Otherwise compare companion count, support from Jupiter/Mercury/classical dispositor by occupation or rashi drishti, exaltation, modality, then longer candidate duration. Withhold unresolved ties. Use the classical dispositor for this comparison to avoid recursion.
vedic/dashas/narayana/periods.yaml.sign_strength: Compare, lexicographically: graha count, count of Jupiter/Mercury/lord occupying or giving rashi drishti (count roles separately), presence of exaltation, lord occupying opposite parity, modality (dual > fixed > movable), then within-sign advancement of lord (reverse for nodes). On an unresolved tie withhold selection.
vedic/dashas/narayana/periods.yaml.simultaneous_exceptions: Saturn precedence when both Saturn and Ketu occupy the seed (KB choice).

traditions_differ.locator: Sanjay Rath, Narayana Dasa; Jaimini Upadesa Sutras 2.4. Edition locator pending.
traditions_differ.selected: Existing trine-wise dual-sign progressions; candidate Rath school, exact attribution unverified.
traditions_differ.variant: Kendra-wise dual-sign order; inactive pending source review.

vedic/dashas/sandhi/periods.yaml.levels: Apply separately to adjacent siblings in a single system and clock, at Maha or subperiod level.

vedic/dashas/vimshottari/modulation.yaml.annotation_policy: Combustion, retrograde, war and vargottama explain terms already included in the KB-35 grade. They have zero additional grading effect. A Viparita exception removes the ordinary dusthana warning. Relate each Moon position and star lord to the bound area.

vedic/dashas/vimshottari/modulation.yaml.relationship_policy: Laghu Parashari: related lords of angles and trines can cooperate within a promised topic; actual functional ownership qualifies the natural friendship.
vedic/dashas/vimshottari/modulation.yaml.same_lord: For Maha and Antar of the same planet retain its own condition once. Suppress relative distance, friendship and shared ownership as duplicate pair testimony.
vedic/dashas/vimshottari/modulation.yaml.scope: Apply lord notes independently to Maha and Antar. Pair notes qualify the narrative, never add votes for natural and compound friendship. A harder pair alone cannot suppress a promised event.

Named formation or convention; wording and display policy are editorial.

vedic/dashas/vimshottari/periods.yaml.clock: Use one pinned year length throughout. Preserve instants, render half-open intervals in the selected zone.
vedic/dashas/vimshottari/periods.yaml.interval: UTC elapsed time, 86400 seconds per day, start inclusive and end exclusive. Retain exact rational endpoints until display.

reading_context.areas: Select the applicable tags of the matched natal entries. Pair tags suggest topics to check. Require matching chart evidence before making an area-specific reading.
reading_context.nodes: Use the node’s occupied house, sign ruler and confirmed associations. Use classical sign rulers for ownership.
reading_context.ownership: For every house ruled by this graha from the natal Lagna, open vedic.house-lords.lord-{owned_house}-in-house-{occupied_house}.
reading_context.pair: Use the Maha lord for the ongoing topic. Use the Antar lord’s own placements and its relationship to the Maha lord to qualify that topic. Require both stable contexts for a paired reading.
reading_context.reference: Stable sidereal D1 whole-sign houses from Lagna. Bind each lookup to the actual period lord and same chart.
reading_context.sign: Open vedic.planets-in-signs.{lord}-{sign} for dignity, degree exceptions and style.

vedic/dashas/vimshottari/periods.yaml.start: Find the lord of the birth Moon nakshatra. Remaining years = lord years × remaining arc / 13°20′. Back-project elapsed balance to the true start of the first major period.
vedic/dashas/vimshottari/periods.yaml.subperiod: Start each period with its own lord then cycle in order. Duration = parent duration × child lord years / 120. Generate children from the full period start, then clip to display range.

vedic/dashas/yogini/periods.yaml.clock_reason: Preserve this system’s dated references independently of the Vimshottari default.
vedic/dashas/yogini/periods.yaml.start: Candidate convention: add three to the one-based birth nakshatra number and take modulo eight, treating zero as eight. Remaining fraction comes from untraversed lunar arc.
vedic/dashas/yogini/periods.yaml.subperiod: Rotate from the parent yogini and allocate duration in proportion to years / 36.

Bhadrika.en: You can ask a question before making a plan.
Bhadrika.hi: योजना बनाने से पहले सवाल पूछ सकते हैं।

Bhramari.en: You can put a practical idea to work.
Bhramari.hi: किसी व्यावहारिक विचार को आज़मा सकते हैं।

Dhanya.en: You may enjoy sharing something you have learned.
Dhanya.hi: सीखी हुई बात साझा करना अच्छा लग सकता है।

Mangala.en: You may find comfort in a familiar routine.
Mangala.hi: परिचित दिनचर्या से सहजता मिल सकती है।

Pingala.en: You can choose a responsibility to take on.
Pingala.hi: आप कोई जिम्मेदारी चुन सकते हैं।

Sankata.en: You can give yourself time to explore an unfamiliar choice.
Sankata.hi: नए विकल्प को समझने के लिए समय ले सकते हैं।

Siddha.en: You may enjoy making a shared space welcoming.
Siddha.hi: साझा जगह को सहज बनाने में आनंद मिल सकता है।

Ulka.en: You can make space for a task that takes patience.
Ulka.hi: धैर्य वाले काम के लिए समय रख सकते हैं।

vedic/dignity/relationships.yaml.distance: One plus (owner D1 sign index minus target D1 sign index) modulo twelve.
vedic/dignity/relationships.yaml.natural_source: Read graha.natural_friendships in the target's vedic/planets entry. Use its directed relationship to the classical owner of the occupied sign.
vedic/dignity/relationships.yaml.unknown_if: Target or owner position or directed relation is missing. Node dignity is unassigned.

label_policy.bounds: Normalize 30 degrees into the next sign. Use [start,end) for MT with the exact exaltation peak taking precedence. Mercury in Virgo below 15 degrees is exalted, above the peak to 20 is MT and from 20 is own. Moon in Taurus below 3 is exalted, exactly 3 is peak and above 3 is MT.
label_policy.unknown_if: Missing position or required relationship. Preserve independent sign memberships.

traditions_differ.note: This table leaves both nodes unassigned. Schools that assign nodal dignities differ on the signs.

vedic/dignity/sign-dignities.yaml.own_sign: Match the sign lord to the graha.
vedic/dignity/sign-dignities.yaml.scope: Independent sign memberships. Keep overlapping flags, including Mercury in Virgo. Peak degree is a separate point. Moolatrikona sign alone does not establish degree-specific dignity.
traditions_differ: CLASSICAL. BPHS 3.54 (tithyamsha) is the default to 15 degrees exclusive; Saravali 1.21–24 and Phaladeepika 1.7 use the five-degree variant. Brihat Jataka I.13–14 identifies the sign only. Edition locators supplied for review.

kaal_sarp.direction: Forward longitude from Rahu to Ketu
kaal_sarp.formation: Check the seven classical longitudes against the selected directed nodal semicircle.

traditions_differ.note: Use, direction and endpoint treatment vary by school.

manglik.pair_comparison: Evaluate partners independently and retain each natal result.
manglik.reference: Evaluate from Lagna first. Moon and Venus reference variants are separate.

relief_profiles.library: Use the stated benefic-contact and pair exceptions plus own/exalted mitigation on the library house list.
relief_profiles.raman: Use the second-house five-list, with separately bound Lagna, Moon or Venus origin. Apply the Raman exceptions to the chosen origin.
relief_profiles.rath: Lagna uses family_five. Moon uses lagna_five. No automatic transfer of another school’s sign exceptions.
relief_profiles.regional-lagna: Regional Lagna-only five- or four-house list with explicitly selected reliefs; textual attribution pending.
relief_profiles.sgs: Use family_five from Lagna, including full Mars aspects to those houses.

traditions_differ.note: Bind the named house list, origin and relief convention before deriving a result.

vedic/doshas/profiles.yaml.sade_sati: Use the three Moon-relative Saturn transit phases, including re-entries. Never present as a natal defect.

vedic/houses/catalog.yaml.scope: Editorial navigation themes for the twelve whole-sign houses. House eight uses neutral wording under the app sensitive-topic policy.

checks: Trace the area lord to its placement and grade.
Inspect functional nature and strength of each occupant.
Compare full aspects on the house and its lord.
Read the relevant significator in context.
context: count the same distance again; explain recurrence.
Confirm using the released area varga.
context: explain sign support only when available.

karaka_bhava_nashaya.method: Use house natural karakas; Jupiter with children or Venus with partnership in its own topic house qualifies expectations. Some traditions require affliction; never add another promise count.
karaka_bhava_nashaya.source: Uttara Kalamrita, bhava karakas; edition/locator pending.

karaka_traditions.default_source: Uttara Kalamrita, Kanda V (edition and precise locator pending). Use house-specific significators in the house catalogue.
karaka_traditions.effect: Soften the corresponding karaka testimony. Do not increment a separate promise factor.
karaka_traditions.variant: Phaladeepika XV includes alternative significators. Some traditions require another affliction to apply the caution.

vedic/houses/judgement.yaml.scope: Aspect pairs deliberately cover Jupiter, Saturn and Mars to Moon, Venus and partnership/career lords. Other pairs enter the general full-aspect test. The six promise factors and their count are owned by life-areas/pipeline.yaml.

vedic/karakas/natural.yaml.method: Natural graha associations used for routing; verify alongside house lords and relevant divisions.
vedic/karakas/natural.yaml.source: Brihat Jataka II.1 and editorial topic routing. Confirm each expanded association before publication.

mercury.traditions_differ: The eighth can receive more weight than the fifth.

saturn.traditions_differ: The ninth can receive more weight than the eighth.

jupiter.traditions_differ: The fifth can receive more weight than the eighth.

mars.traditions_differ: The MT sign weighs sixth ownership against ascendant ownership.

venus.traditions_differ: The MT sign weighs sixth ownership against ascendant ownership.

saturn.traditions_differ: Sixth ownership can receive more weight than fifth ownership.

conditional_flags.eighth_lord: Laghu Parashari: Aries Mars and Libra Venus own both Lagna and the eighth; do not apply a separate eighth-lord penalty.
conditional_flags.node_yogakaraka: BPHS ch.34: a node in a kendra associated with a trikona lord, or in a trikona associated with a kendra lord, can participate in yoga. This chart-dependent flag grants no permanent sign ownership.

vedic/lordships/functional.yaml.kendradhipati_policy: The flag indicates eligibility. Apply to a naturally benefic Mercury or waxing Moon under the natural profile; a naturally malefic pure kendra lord also resolves Neutral. Strong qualifies Jupiter or Venus in a dual Lagna.
vedic/lordships/functional.yaml.maraka_policy: Staff metadata only. Excluded from tone, public copy and longevity assessment.
vedic/lordships/functional.yaml.mt_policy: On dual ownership keep the MT house for commentary. The MT annotation does not override the selected per-Lagna list.
vedic/lordships/functional.yaml.node_policy: Use the resolved occupied-house testimony first, then association, then sign dispositor. Node ownership is always empty. Evaluate the separate conditional association flag for the current chart. Missing chart data is unknown.
vedic/lordships/functional.yaml.scope: Classical per-Lagna lists (BPHS chapter 34 and Laghu Parashari chapter 2). Generic first-match order below is the named MODERN variant generic-lordship-order.
vedic/lordships/functional.yaml.traditions_differ: Generic ownership and dispositor-only node readings remain alternatives. The default gives priority to the individual classical Lagna lists.

access.aggregation: For northern factors a maximum is supportive, zero invites care, and intermediate points give context. Parihara changes a care signal to context while preserving raw points. For southern factors an agreement is supportive and a listed obstruction invites care; a partial match or unclassified relationship gives context. A shared sign gives context in southern Rashi. All supportive gives Supportive, all care gives Take care, and mixed or contextual evidence gives Steady. No public total or cutoff. Do not combine the two profiles.
access.cross_checks: Chart and Manglik context are separate from factor aggregation. Relationship decisions belong to both people.
access.missing: Withhold the reading when consent, row/column choice or stable Moon inputs are missing. Independently withhold unavailable timed-chart context.

vedic/matching/factors.yaml.dashakoota: Separate southern profile: Dina, Gana, Mahendra, Stree Deergha, Yoni, Rashi, Rashi lord, Vashya, Rajju, Vedha. Never convert to 36 points.
dependencies: tara: inclusive birth-star distance in both directions
graha-maitri: relationships of Moon sign lords
vedic/matching/factors.yaml.exceptions: Keep Nadi and Bhakoot parihara reasons beside the raw points. Evaluate Manglik for each chart under the same profile; never infer consent or a marriage decision.
vedic/matching/factors.yaml.parihara_selection: Keep the KB-10 softening variant or explicitly select Raman's cancellation variant for each factor. Preserve raw admin points and the selected reason. Either relief makes that factor contextual in the public synthesis. Do not apply both explanations to one factor.

reference.bhakoot_reference_correction: The pinned PyJHora array gives seven in the Aquarius-row/Cancer-column cell. The inclusive distances are six and eight. Both directions use zero in this KB and in the fixed reference.
reference.convention: Both stars numbered from Ashwini. Each pada is sampled at its exact midpoint. The two readable columns use the first pada. Each digest covers all sixteen ordered pada pairs in row-major order. Join the comma-separated factor rows with LF, no trailing LF, booleans as 1 or 0.
reference.provenance: Independent reference transcription of pinned PyJHora class matrices and Raman's Marriage sections. Exact sign halves, elemental Varna, the existing two-direction Tara convention, and the named southern choices follow this library. For southern partial Gana the stored bit records base agreement; for same-sign Rashi it is zero.

vedic/matching/north-profile.yaml.bhakoot: Award 0 for 2/12, 5/9 or 6/8 sign relationships, otherwise 7 in the base table. Keep a separately reviewed exception for identical or mutually friendly sign lords.
vedic/matching/north-profile.yaml.matrix_order: First use the declared row partner (traditional bride role), then column partner (traditional groom role). Ask for the intended roles for asymmetric tables. Never infer either from a name.
vedic/matching/north-profile.yaml.nadi: Repeat 0,1,2,2,1,0 across the 27 birth stars from Ashwini. Different classes give 8, identical classes 0. Treat same-star/different-pada parihara as an explicitly selected variant.
vedic/matching/north-profile.yaml.parihara: Keep raw points and exception reasoning separate. Varna is a traditional chart grouping and carries no inference about a person’s caste.
vedic/matching/north-profile.yaml.source: PyJHora compatibility.py, revision f8c6de2f54338752bdb667384a8b0ca5791c5bdf. Matrix source for the named northern profile. Entry-specific rules document differences.
vedic/matching/north-profile.yaml.tara: For each direction cycle the inclusive star count through nine. This profile awards 1.5 for each remainder other than 3, 5, 7. Both inclusive counts equal one for a shared star.

vashya_members.human: Gemini, Virgo, Libra, first half Sagittarius, Aquarius
vashya_members.quadruped: Aries, Taurus, second half Sagittarius, first half Capricorn

vedic/matching/south-profile.yaml.orientation: Declared row to column, both endpoints inclusive. Same sign is contextual for Rashi. A boolean records the base agreement only. Do not sum the ten factors.

sources.supports: Southern factor definitions; selected thresholds and treatment of partial agreement form a named profile.

bhakoot-relief.en: A traditional exception may bring shared priorities into focus.
bhakoot-relief.hi: एक पारंपरिक अपवाद साझा प्राथमिकताएँ सामने ला सकता है।

care.en: Different expectations may benefit from a little more conversation.
care.hi: अलग उम्मीदों पर थोड़ी और बातचीत मदद कर सकती है।

close.en: The traditional reading may highlight areas of easy understanding.
close.hi: पारंपरिक संकेत आपसी समझ के सहज पहलू दिखा सकते हैं।
close.kn: ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಓದು ಸುಲಭ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸಬಹುದು.

d9.en: Shared values may give a conversation about commitment a starting point.
d9.hi: साझा मूल्य प्रतिबद्धता की बातचीत का आधार बन सकते हैं।

kuja-balance.en: You may recognise a similar way of responding under pressure.
kuja-balance.hi: दबाव में प्रतिक्रिया देने का मिलता-जुलता तरीका दिख सकता है।

kuja-difference.en: You can discuss how each of you prefers to resolve disagreements.
kuja-difference.hi: असहमति सुलझाने की अपनी पसंद पर आप बात कर सकते हैं।

mixed.en: The traditional reading may bring out both shared habits and differences worth discussing.
mixed.hi: पारंपरिक संकेत साझा आदतें और बातचीत योग्य अंतर दिखा सकते हैं।
mixed.kn: ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಓದು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಗಳನ್ನೂ ಮಾತನಾಡಬಹುದಾದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಗಳನ್ನೂ ತೋರಿಸಬಹುದು.

moon-lagna.en: You can share how you like others to respond to your feelings.
moon-lagna.hi: आप बता सकते हैं कि अपनी भावनाओं पर कैसी प्रतिक्रिया चाहते हैं।
moon-lagna.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಭಾವನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಯಾವ ಸ್ಪಂದನೆ ಬೇಕೆಂದು ಹೇಳಬಹುದು.

nadi-relief.en: A traditional exception may soften a difference in everyday rhythms.
nadi-relief.hi: परंपरा में एक अपवाद रोज़मर्रा की लय के अंतर को हल्का कर सकता है।

partnership.en: You can compare expectations about commitment.
partnership.hi: प्रतिबद्धता की उम्मीदों पर बात कर सकते हैं।

period.en: You may want to compare when each of you feels ready for a change.
period.hi: बदलाव के लिए कब तैयार महसूस करते हैं, इस पर बात कर सकते हैं।

prompt.en: You can ask how each of you would like to share everyday responsibilities.
prompt.hi: आप पूछ सकते हैं कि रोज़मर्रा की ज़िम्मेदारियाँ कैसे बाँटी जाएँ।
prompt.kn: ದೈನಂದಿನ ಹೊಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಕೇಳಬಹುದು.

understanding.en: You can start by sharing what each of you needs.
understanding.hi: पहले आप एक दूसरे की ज़रूरतें साझा कर सकते हैं।

vedic/matching/summary.yaml.method: North only. Require consent, stable lunar factors and a complete raw koota table. Editorial baseline bands [0,18), [18,25), [25,36]. Never alter the raw total for exceptions. South uses its independent Porutham recipe.
vedic/matching/summary.yaml.papasamya: Compare remaining eligible placements separately from the base koota picture. Report balance context only.
vedic/matching/summary.yaml.resolution: Start with caution, neutral or support from the band. Append uncancelled Nadi/Bhakoot cautions once; evaluate their matching exceptions before voting. Apply individual Kuja cancellations then pair comparability: only unmatched residual Kuja adds caution. Compare distinct cross-chart reasons; discard unknown. Support alone gives Supportive, caution alone Take care; conflicting or neutral gives Steady. Do not include numbers in public data.

vedic/muhurta/activity-factors.yaml.exceptions: Pushya preference excluded for marriage in this candidate profile. Apply activity-specific, participant, calendar and local exclusions independently.
vedic/muhurta/activity-factors.yaml.scope: Draft daytime profile. These are soft star preferences for optional ordering after hard-exclusion filtering. Confirm regional edition before enabling. No date is universally suitable.
vedic/muhurta/activity-factors.yaml.source_locator: Muhurta Chintamani, chapter 1, star classes (edition pending). Abhijit is excluded from the 27-star frame.

vedic/muhurta/ranking-policy.yaml.additional_gates: Apply the hard and soft predicates of each activity and enabled regional switches. Split at all change instants. Missing hard inputs withhold; positive overlap excludes. Evaluate star yogas only on survivors.
vedic/muhurta/ranking-policy.yaml.aggregation: For each channel retain directional evidence as a set; preserve participant identity. Never average partner results. Deduplicate correlated evidence: do not count Panchaka as an additional independent reason alongside its component limbs and lagna. Limit evidence if fewer than three independent reason channels are available (complete neutral observations can explain a channel).
vedic/muhurta/ranking-policy.yaml.bounds: Split requested ranges at sunrise, sunset, exact limb/pada/lagna/D9 crossings, Rahu Kalam endpoints and relevant combustion threshold or motion changes. Evaluate half-open pieces. If an indivisible requested interval intersects a hard exclusion for positive duration, exclude it.

chandra.formula: 1 + ((event Moon sign − natal Moon sign) modulo 12).

vedic/muhurta/ranking-policy.yaml.combustion: Use vedic/states/combustion-orbs.yaml at the election instant with shortest circular Sun–graha separation. Equality is combust. At an unresolved motion branch use a result only if both possible thresholds agree on the classification; otherwise withhold.
vedic/muhurta/ranking-policy.yaml.eligibility: Hard exclusions override every relief and omit the interval. For a directly inspected blocked interval show Take care. Missing required evidence yields limited evidence with no rank or tone. For marriage require two distinct natal charts.

panchaka.formula: (full tithi 1..30 + sunrise weekday Sunday=1 + star Ashwini=1 + election lagna Aries=1) modulo 9
panchaka.remaining: Apply the activity-specific panchaka_avoid list. Unselected non-clear remainders are neutral.
panchaka.traditions_differ: This is the remainder-based election test. Regional nakshatra Panchaka and fortnight-relative tithi methods are different tests. Vehicle handover inherits travel caution; registration inherits property caution; naming and study use the ceremonial analogy.

vedic/muhurta/ranking-policy.yaml.preferences: Use full one-based tithi, KB-03 star ID, KB-19 case-sensitive yoga and karana names, and D1 election lagna. Values absent from both lists are neutral. A listed cautionary star quarter supersedes support from the same star.
vedic/muhurta/ranking-policy.yaml.public_projection: Localized tone label, localized user_text, and ordinary local date/time when displaying a schedule. No scores, numeric rule evidence, participant counts, formula outputs or technical chains in user_text.

reliefs.chandra: For the same participant: the election Moon is eighth from the natal Moon and their Tara category is supportive. Soften only their eighth-house Chandra caution to neutral.
reliefs.entry-navamsa: For house entry: the election lagna is movable and its KB-11 D9 sign is Taurus. Cancel only the movable-lagna caution.
reliefs.janma-star: For first letters or the purchase-registration of land, the election star is the participant’s actual birth star. Cancel only that participant’s Janma Tara caution; another star in the same Tara class does not qualify.
reliefs.naming-tuesday: For naming on Tuesday: the local civil date is the tenth, twelfth or sixteenth day counted inclusively from the child’s local birth date. Cancel only the Tuesday caution.

vedic/muhurta/ranking-policy.yaml.scope: KB-20 daytime activity profiles; evaluate in the current city using KB-19 sunrise, weekday and limbs.

sources.other_locator: The Birth Star and the Birth Moon; Special Adverse Yogas and their Neutralisation
sources.supports: Tara count, Panchaka arithmetic, Vishti and qualified relief. Qualitative cutoffs are Bhava360 selections.
Marriage election tradition. The angular combustion thresholds are the specified KB proxy.

tara.formula: 1 + (((event star − natal star) modulo 27) modulo 9), same star counts as one.

vedic/muhurta/ranking-policy.yaml.tie_break: Earlier start, then earlier end, within each tone. Deduplicate identical activity, participants, city and interval. Keep excluded and unresolved windows outside the recommendation list.
vedic/muhurta/ranking-policy.yaml.tone_resolution: After named reliefs: only supportive directions gives Supportive; only caution directions gives Take care; mixed or all neutral gives Steady. No points, weights or tally of favourable signals.

vedic/muhurta/region-policy.yaml.gandanta: Withhold an auspicious recommendation when election Moon or Lagna crosses the selected gandanta interval. Use vedic/vargas/advanced.yaml; unresolved interval is unknown.
vedic/muhurta/region-policy.yaml.selection: General Indian draft. Opt-in northern regional seasons and local Panchaka restrictions; store chosen switches with each query.

sources.locator: Vivaha and Shubhashubha prakaranas; regional rules require review.

adhika.when: Intercalary lunar month (no ingress between consecutive new moons).

asta.when: Guru or Shukra combust under the selected profile. Regional alternative uses observed local invisibility days instead.

chaturmas.when: Ashadha Shukla Ekadashi through Kartika Shukla Ekadashi, ending at the latter observance.

holashtak.when: Phalguna Shukla Ashtami through Purnima inclusive.

kharmas.when: Sidereal Sun in Sagittarius or Pisces.

panchaka.when: Sidereal Moon in [300,360) degrees, Dhanishta second half through Revati. Regional travel restriction applies to southbound departures.

vedic/muhurta/selection.yaml.chandra: Count window Moon from each natal Moon inclusively. Base supportive houses 1,3,6,7,10,11; lunar-phase variants separate.
vedic/muhurta/selection.yaml.participants: Use the required natal chart or charts in the selected activity profile. Rank surviving windows by ranking_policy; use existing draft preferences for activities outside KB-20.
vedic/muhurta/selection.yaml.partition: Partition the requested range at all relevant sunrise, sunset, limb, exclusion and participant-strength boundaries. Use half-open windows.
vedic/muhurta/selection.yaml.tara: Count inclusively from birth star to window star, wrap 27 then cycle 1..9. Categories 2,4,6,8,9 support this profile.

vedic/nakshatras/catalog.yaml.lord_review: Phaladeepika XIX.2, Sastri second edition, begins with the Sun at Krittika; rotated to Ashwini this sequence begins with Ketu.
vedic/nakshatras/catalog.yaml.sequence_source: Nitya Deepam, name syllables table, sidereal span column

sources.other_locator: Divisional dignity and planetary states chapters
sources.supports: Traditional calculation or classification. Reflective wording is editorial.

steps: Read Moon or stable Lagna star.
Use its exact quarter row to bind navamsha reflection.
Select the one star-lord context; do not add another grade vote.

vedic/padas/namakshar.yaml.locator: Name syllables for each pada of the twenty-seven nakshatras, columns Pada 1 through Pada 4
vedic/padas/namakshar.yaml.scope: Lookup by stable birth Moon nakshatra ID and one-based pada. Roman tokens preserve this source’s spelling. Local-script pronunciation needs native review, especially where Roman tokens coincide.
vedic/padas/namakshar.yaml.traditions_differ: Regional lists vary, including Purva Ashadha and Uttara Bhadrapada. Keep each list under its own profile.

vedic/panchang/calendar-profiles.yaml.deepavali: For Lakshmi Puja use regular Ashvina Amavasya in amanta (Kartika Krishna in purnimanta). Choose the local date whose pradosha intersects the tithi; if both qualify choose later. If neither qualifies, withhold this profile’s date and request the applicable regional yama-based determination.
vedic/panchang/calendar-profiles.yaml.month_bounds: New moon inclusive to next new moon exclusive. Count solved forward sidereal solar sign ingresses inside. One names an ordinary month; zero takes the following ingress name and marks adhika; two record both ingress names and flag kshaya for regional handling.
vedic/panchang/calendar-profiles.yaml.pradosha: For this evening profile use the first fifth of sunset-to-next-sunrise; require strictly positive overlap. Other authorities measure evening in ghatis.
vedic/panchang/calendar-profiles.yaml.purnimanta: Bright fortnight uses the same month name as amanta. During the dark fortnight label by the next bright fortnight; preserve intercalary status and profile. An unresolved exceptional month mapping suppresses a dated festival.
vedic/panchang/calendar-profiles.yaml.sankranti: An ingress instant belongs to the sunrise-to-sunrise day containing it. This is a transit-day marker; ritual observance may move to another civil date.

sources.supports: Ingress-based month naming and intercalation.
Calendar new year in Chaitra, including intercalary Chaitra in this tradition.
Choice of date when one, both or neither sunrise carries Pratipada.

sources.other_locator: Ashvina-masa determination, Pradosha and Yama comparison
sources.supports: Evening observance and competing date rules; the regional profile below states its window and fallback.

sources.book: How Diwali and Lakshmi Puja Are Dated
sources.other_locator: Lakshmi Puja in pradosh; both evenings
sources.supports: Later-evening choice when both qualify in this profile.

vedic/panchang/calendar-profiles.yaml.ugadi: Use the first Chaitra lunation of the amanta year (including adhika Chaitra in this profile). Select the sunrise in Shukla Pratipada. For two matching sunrises use the earlier. For none use the sunrise immediately preceding the start of Pratipada.
vedic/panchang/calendar-profiles.yaml.zone: Use the selected city’s time zone and local date.

vedic/panchang/day-night.yaml.clock: Day = sunrise to sunset; night = sunset to next local sunrise. Divide each into eight equal elapsed-time intervals. End boundary belongs to the following interval.

sources.supports: Weekday starting labels and distinct day and night sequences.

sources.book: The Thirty Muhurtas of Day and Night
sources.supports: Seasonal day and night division and the named slots.
Sunrise day and hour lords; seasonal subdivision is the product convention.

vedic/panchang/day-night.yaml.window_formula: For anchors A,B and one-based slot j of n return [A+(j-1)(B-A)/n, A+j(B-A)/n). Use elapsed time, then convert to local display. For Brahma preceding a sunrise use the preceding sunset as A and that sunrise as B.

vedic/panchang/election-intervals.yaml.indexing: One-based fifteenths of actual daytime or following night. PyJHora 5.0.6 index convention; other almanacs differ.
vedic/panchang/election-intervals.yaml.scale: Use actual end minus beginning of the nakshatra. One ghati is one sixtieth of that duration. Use half-open intervals; Mula has two exclusions.

sources.locator: jhora/const.py amrita_gadiya_varjyam_star_map; sarvartha_siddha_yoga; amrita_siddha_yoga_dict; disha_shool_map; jhora/panchanga/drik.py durmuhurtam

vedic/panchang/election-intervals.yaml.traditions_differ: Preserve the existing Ardra 21-ghati convention; 11 is an almanac alternative pending edition verification. Thursday/Friday durmuhurta use the recorded PyJHora slots; local almanacs can differ, and must be represented as a complete alternate profile.

vedic/panchang/election-yogas.yaml.chandrashtama: Eighth sign inclusively from participant Moon, caution for new starts and travel.

election_latta.order: Inclusive signed star count; wrap 27. Apply only to the malefics present in the selected election doctrine.
election_latta.source: PyJHora 5.0.6 jhora/const.py latta_stars_of_planets (checked). Separate from the forward/reverse Moon transit Vedha table.

vedic/panchang/election-yogas.yaml.role: Soft context only; auspicious combinations never override a hard exclusion.

sources.locator: jhora/const.py amrita_gadiya_varjyam_star_map; sarvartha_siddha_yoga; amrita_siddha_yoga_dict; disha_shool_map; jhora/panchanga/drik.py durmuhurtam

vedic/panchang/limb-tables.yaml.angular_basis: Unrounded geocentric apparent sidereal longitudes in the same Lahiri frame at the query instant. One turn is 1296000 arcseconds. All intervals include the lower boundary and exclude the upper.

sources.supports: Elongation, fortnight and lunar-day names.
Sunrise day and hour lords; seasonal subdivision is the product convention.
Sun–Moon sum and ordered yoga names.
Four fixed and seven repeating half-tithi names.
Equal stellar divisions; canonical IDs and spans come from KB-03.

vedic/panchang/limbs.yaml.boundaries: For tithi, karana, nakshatra and yoga solve the bracketing crossings of the continuously unwrapped angle (Moon minus Sun, Moon minus Sun, Moon, Moon plus Sun respectively) through integer multiples of its width. Retain the actual instants. At a crossing select the new interval; do not extrapolate a fixed lunar speed.
vedic/panchang/limbs.yaml.karana: Index lunar elongation in 6° half-tithis from zero. Index 0 Kimstughna; 1..56 cycle Bava, Balava, Kaulava, Taitila, Gara, Vanija, Vishti; 57..59 Shakuni, Chatushpada, Naga.
vedic/panchang/limbs.yaml.location: Use the selected current city, timezone and apparent upper-limb sunrise with refraction. Compute neighboring local sunrise and sunset as instants. Angular limbs do not depend on the availability of sunrise.
vedic/panchang/limbs.yaml.origin: Local sunrise changes vara; angular limb changes occur at their exact ephemeris crossings.

other_intervals.abhijit: Eighth of fifteen equal daylight muhurtas.
other_intervals.brahma: Traditional pre-sunrise interval under chosen night-length convention.
other_intervals.choghadiya: Eight intervals each by day and night; use the appropriate weekday sequence.
other_intervals.durmuhurta: Use weekday-specific muhurta indexes, including separate night rules.
other_intervals.hora: Divide day and night separately into twelve. Start at weekday lord and repeat Saturn/Jupiter/Mars/Sun/Venus/Mercury/Moon cyclically.
other_intervals.varjyam-amrit: Use nakshatra-specific offsets scaled to the actual nakshatra interval.

vedic/panchang/limbs.yaml.polar: No daylight-derived window when the required sunrise or sunset is unavailable.
vedic/panchang/limbs.yaml.sunrise_anomalies: Compare unwrapped tithi indices at consecutive sunrises: equal means repeated; a jump exceeding one skips every intervening index in the sunrise labels. Each intervening angular interval still exists.
vedic/panchang/limbs.yaml.sunrise_rules: Repeated tithi at successive sunrises and a tithi entirely between sunrises need separate festival rules. Keep regional amanta/purnimanta profiles.
vedic/panchang/limbs.yaml.tithi: 1 + floor(((Moon − Sun) mod 360) / 12). First 15 waxing, next 15 waning.
vedic/panchang/limbs.yaml.tithi_binding: Local day labels use the tithi at apparent sunrise. Festival-specific observance rules may bind another limb/time. Elections use the actual instantaneous tithi throughout each candidate interval.
vedic/panchang/limbs.yaml.vara: Weekday of the most recent local sunrise.

vedic/panchang/rise-set.yaml.record: Store the backend actually used. Resolve from position return flags with the same ephemeris configuration and body at the event. The rise routine returns an event status, not ephemeris flags.

sunrise.traditional-disc-centre.use: Override only sunrise event bits. Record the method on the day and its dependent windows. Tithi-at-sunrise selection and Rahu kaal timing can differ on edge days, even for a one-to-two-minute shift. The actual shift depends on place and date.

mercury.method: Count other grahas in Mercury's D1 sign. Malefic only when malefics outnumber benefics. Count both nodes and use the selected Moon class.
mercury.traditions_differ: Strict association is the BPHS 3.11 variant. Predominance is an editorial default; the proposed Phaladeepika ch.2 locator remains unverified.

moon.note: The alternative uses measured elongation. A 72-degree threshold is distinct from the start of Ashtami at 84 degrees.

bright-72.basis: Bhava360 symmetric brightness convention; classical locator unverified.

vedic/planets/benefic-profile.yaml.sources_note: BPHS 3.11 for waning Moon; Raman Graha and Bhava Balas, Paksha Bala sections 52–53 for the Ashtami window. Primary locators pending inspection.
vedic/planets/benefic-profile.yaml.unknown_if: A missing longitude or unresolved Moon class could change the requested classification.

vedic/planets/catalog.yaml.node_definition: Rahu is the selected ascending lunar node. Ketu is its antipode. Record mean or true node in the calculation result.

vedic/prashna/judgment.yaml.actors: Test question Lagna lord to primary topic lord and Moon to primary topic lord. Deduplicate unordered pairs; omit self-pairs. Context houses explain scope and do not cast independent votes. For lost-item recovery also test the fourth lord occupying the ascendant (Prasna Tantra III.76).
vedic/prashna/judgment.yaml.contact: Use the shared mean orb and signed angular residual; separating contacts are background. Conjunction stays context in the standalone question method.
vedic/prashna/judgment.yaml.reason_binding: For a qualifying pair use querent-support or querent-friction when the source is the ascendant lord, otherwise moon-support or moon-friction. The fourth lord in the ascendant supplies recovery-context only on the lost-item route. Emit each reason once.

moon-friction.en: Changing circumstances may call for another look at your plans.
moon-friction.hi: बदलते हालात में आप अपनी योजना पर फिर विचार कर सकते हैं।
moon-friction.kn: ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಯೋಜನೆಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಬಹುದು.

moon-support.en: The way the situation is unfolding may give you an opening.
moon-support.hi: हालात जिस तरह बदल रहे हैं, उनसे आपको एक अवसर मिल सकता है।
moon-support.kn: ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಸಾಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ರೀತಿಯಿಂದ ನಿಮಗೆ ಒಂದು ಅವಕಾಶ ಸಿಗಬಹುದು.

nakta.en: An intermediary may help bring the plans together.
nakta.hi: मध्यस्थ योजनाओं में तालमेल बनाने में मदद कर सकता है।

querent-friction.en: Your plans may need an adjustment before you can move ahead.
querent-friction.hi: आगे बढ़ने से पहले आपको अपनी योजना में कुछ बदलाव करना पड़ सकता है।
querent-friction.kn: ಮುಂದೆ ಸಾಗಲು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಯೋಜನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಬೇಕಾಗಬಹುದು.

querent-support.en: Your plans and the matter you asked about may be coming together.
querent-support.hi: आपकी योजना और जिस विषय पर आपने पूछा है, उनमें तालमेल बन सकता है।
querent-support.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನೀವು ಕೇಳಿದ ವಿಷಯ ಒಂದಕ್ಕೊಂದು ಹೊಂದಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು.

reception.en: Each side may have something useful to offer the other.
reception.hi: दोनों पक्ष एक दूसरे की मदद कर सकते हैं।

recovery-context.en: The reading suggests that another search may be worthwhile.
recovery-context.hi: इस संकेत के आधार पर एक बार फिर तलाश करना उपयोगी हो सकता है।
recovery-context.kn: ಇನ್ನೊಮ್ಮೆ ಹುಡುಕುವುದು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತವಾಗಬಹುದು ಎಂಬ ಸೂಚನೆ ಇದೆ.

yamaya.en: A shared contact may help coordinate the next step.
yamaya.hi: साझा संपर्क अगले कदम में मदद कर सकता है।

vedic/prashna/judgment.yaml.reuse: Nakta, Yamaya and mutual reception are bound once using vedic/tajika/aspects.yaml. Incomplete history or an interrupted transfer withholds that testimony.

sources.other_locator: Bhava Prasna, General Estimate and Success of Object in View
sources.supports: Ascendant lord, question lord and lunar testimony. The evidence categories and timing gate are editorial.

sources.other_locator: 29.1; 29.2.3 Ithasala and preceding Tajaka aspect-orb discussion
sources.supports: Applying contacts, overlapping planetary orbs and application to Prashna.

vedic/prashna/judgment.yaml.strength: Grade Lagna lord in D1 and stable Navamsha separately; note own/exalted, neutral or impaired, combustion and applying Moon contact. Reception or a proven transfer qualifies the outcome; never manufacture a review date.
vedic/prashna/judgment.yaml.strength_context: Read the question Lagna, its ruler in D1, their stable navamsha, and Moon dignity and phase as capacity context. An unstable navamsha is withheld. Mutual reception qualifies an existing leaning. A verified, uninterrupted translation or collection may contribute support. Neither witness supplies a date on its own.
vedic/prashna/judgment.yaml.timing: Verify the earliest forward perfection before a station or intervening prohibition, within the query horizon. A sign ingress alone does not end the contact. Report its local civil date as a review date.
vedic/prashna/judgment.yaml.traditions_differ: Use observed motion here. Symbolic sign-modality time units are a separate tradition.
vedic/prashna/judgment.yaml.unknown: Missing primary, Moon, position or motion inputs leaves insufficient evidence. A separating contact alone cannot produce a negative verdict.

vedic/prashna/kerala-study.yaml.access: Require explicit Kerala study mode and authorized staff. Public intent referrals precede all calculations.
vedic/prashna/kerala-study.yaml.ashtamangala: Three actually counted heaps; reduce each count modulo eight with zero as eight. Do not synthesize a heap.
vedic/prashna/kerala-study.yaml.badhaka: Movable rising sign: eleventh lord. Fixed: ninth lord. Dual: seventh lord. Withhold on unstable Lagna. Private study only; no health, longevity or personal accusation.

sources.edition: B.V. Raman, Part I (source register prashna-marga-raman)
sources.other_locator: Kerala observations, Trisphuta and Badhaka chapters; locator pending
sources.supports: Traditional calculation or classification. Reflective wording is editorial.

vedic/prashna/kerala-study.yaml.trisphuta: Normalize question Lagna + Moon + Gulika longitudes in the same sidereal frame. Missing Gulika or horizon withholds.

vedic/prashna/questions.yaml.chart: Cast one sidereal Lahiri whole-sign D1 for the accepted question at the current location. Preserve the UTC instant and local civil date, time, offset and weekday. For ambiguous civil times require the offset or fold. An invalid local time is unresolved.
inputs: accepted question ID and instant with UTC offset
current city, coordinates and IANA zone
vedic/prashna/questions.yaml.method: Standard house routing uses the question chart. Kerala observation and KP number horary are separately selected modes; neither contributes extra votes to a standard reading.
vedic/prashna/questions.yaml.output: Lead with a provisional leaning, give deduplicated testimony and a practical action; attach timing only under judgment.yaml. Missing evidence is distinct from complete but inconclusive evidence.

exam.scope: An assessment of learning; use education and fulfilment as context.
exam.timing_method: Earliest unimpeded application of querent or Moon to the bound exam lord. Review on local date of verified perfection.

health.scope: House mapping for catalogue purposes only. The public route displays the existing health referral immediately.

job.scope: A specific job application or offer; the sixth supplies service context, the eleventh gains.
job.timing_method: Earliest unimpeded application of querent or Moon to the bound job lord. Review on local date of verified perfection.

litigation.scope: For administrative study bind the first to the querent, the seventh to the opposing party, the sixth to the dispute and the tenth to authority. Public legal requests use the existing legal referral.

lost-item.scope: Recovery of a misplaced possession. The fourth is the recovery reference; the second describes the possession. One additional recovery testimony is the fourth lord occupying the question ascendant.
lost-item.timing_method: Earliest unimpeded application of querent or Moon to the bound lost-item lord. Review on local date of verified perfection.

marriage.scope: A question about a proposed partnership or marriage; family and shared plans provide context.
marriage.timing_method: Earliest unimpeded application of querent or Moon to the bound marriage lord. Review on local date of verified perfection.

property.scope: A home or land inquiry. The fourth describes the property, the second resources and the eleventh fulfilment. Contract or title-law questions use the legal boundary.
property.timing_method: Earliest unimpeded application of querent or Moon to the bound property lord. Review on local date of verified perfection.

return-person.scope: Agreed return of a known traveller; bind home and journey as context. Missing-person or safety concerns are outside this route.
return-person.timing_method: Earliest unimpeded application of querent or Moon to the bound return-person lord. Review on local date of verified perfection.

travel.scope: Use the third for a short or local trip and the ninth for a long journey. Bind the stated trip type; the fourth can describe the return.
travel.timing_method: Earliest unimpeded application of querent or Moon to the bound travel lord. Review on local date of verified perfection.

vedic/prashna/questions.yaml.sensitive_routing: Check requested intent before chart or method selection, including repeat questions and KP. Health, diagnostic, legal-outcome and legal-advice requests use shared/boundaries/responses.yaml. No outcome or timing for health or litigation, including admin study. Lost-item questions never identify a person, allege theft or state a definite location. A missing person is outside this item route.

vedic/rectification/candidates.yaml.method: Compare candidate instants within a stated interval against volunteered dated events using the same timing profile. Preserve competing candidates and their sensitivity. A candidate never silently replaces the recorded birth time.

vedic/rectification/method.yaml.consent: Explicit optional consent before storing event type, date and certainty.

copy.en: If you like, you can recall a change in your work or family around that time.
copy.hi: चाहें तो उस समय काम या परिवार में आए बदलाव पर विचार कर सकते हैं।
copy.kn: ಇಷ್ಟವಿದ್ದರೆ ಆ ಸಮಯದ ಕೆಲಸ ಅಥವಾ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು.

vedic/rectification/method.yaml.evidence: At each candidate and dated independent event, bind KB-38 area rulers to Maha, Antar and Pratyantar. Use KB-36 double transit and Mars/Sun triggers retrospectively. Do not adjust event dates.
vedic/rectification/method.yaml.rank: Rank candidates by counts of independent Antar then Pratyantar matches, dated transit fits, and reported certainty. Optional temperament and Kunda are low-weight tie context only. Preserve ties and residual interval.
vedic/rectification/method.yaml.retry: Where marriage or children fit no candidate, check IANA historical offset, AM/PM and place. Declining leaves declared precision unchanged.
sources: K.N. Rao event-matching practice, edition locator pending
Consultation method §2.3 C-VER-05/06, supplied in brief

vedic/special-lagnas/calculations.yaml.coordinates: Normalize longitudes to 0 inclusive, 360 exclusive; use elapsed time since most recent local sunrise.

definitions.bhava: Sun at sunrise + 15 degrees per hour elapsed
definitions.ghati: Sun at sunrise + 75 degrees per hour elapsed
definitions.hora: Sun at sunrise + 30 degrees per hour elapsed
definitions.indu: Add kala values of ninth lords from Moon and Lagna. Remainder modulo 12, zero as 12. Count inclusively from Moon. Retain Moon degree. Sun through Saturn kala: 30,16,6,8,10,12,1.
definitions.pranapada: Sun + 15 degrees per elapsed vighati; add 0/240/120 degrees for movable/fixed/dual Sun sign.
definitions.sree: Lagna + 360 times fractional progress of Moon through its star
definitions.varnada: Count Lagna and Hora Lagna forward from Aries for odd signs, backward from Pisces for even. Same parity of counts: sum; different: absolute difference. Count resulting odd number forward from Aries, even backward from Pisces (zero = 12).

sources.other_locator: Divisional dignity and planetary states chapters
sources.supports: Traditional calculation or classification. Reflective wording is editorial.

vedic/special-lagnas/calculations.yaml.traditions_differ: Varnada variants use other directions and divisional longitudes. This sign-level method alone is selected.

vedic/states/combustion-orbs.yaml.source: Surya Siddhanta IX.6–9 and X.1, adapted for natal longitude

vedic/strength/ashtakavarga/bindu.yaml.accumulate: Start each row at zero. Each contributor adds one to each sign reached by the listed one-based offsets from its own natal sign. Sum the seven target rows by sign for raw SAV.
vedic/strength/ashtakavarga/bindu.yaml.pinda: For each reduced row sum sign bindus × sign weights for Rashi Pinda. Sum reduced bindus in occupied signs × graha weights for Graha Pinda. Add the two for Shodhya Pinda. Use the named weight and occupancy profiles in shodhya-pinda.yaml and shodhana.yaml.
vedic/strength/ashtakavarga/bindu.yaml.reduction: Keep raw BAV/SAV for transit use. On a copy subtract the smallest value in each elemental trine from all three. Then reduce dual-owned signs under the selected occupancy convention.
vedic/strength/ashtakavarga/bindu.yaml.reference: BPHS Santhanam ch.66 and Raman Ashtakavarga System of Prediction, Moon table. CLASSICAL owner-selected edition; primary locator verification pending.
vedic/strength/ashtakavarga/bindu.yaml.visibility: Numeric evidence for admin and tester roles only.

vedic/strength/ashtakavarga/pinda-compar.occupancy: Includes Lagna and nodes under this comparison profile.
vedic/strength/ashtakavarga/pinda-compar.reference: PyJHora pvr_tests.py, chapter 12.3, chart 7; sp_e_book. Book values as transcribed in upstream benchmark.
vedic/strength/ashtakavarga/pinda-compar.release: Keep Pinda evidence internal until any differences are reconciled against an approved edition.

cases.both_empty_unequal: Set both to the smaller value.
cases.one_occupied: Retain occupied value. Empty value becomes zero if less than or equal to occupied, otherwise reduce it to the occupied value.

vedic/strength/ashtakavarga/reductions.y.occupancy: Default to the seven natal grahas. Only the separately labeled comparison uses its expanded occupancy mask.

worked_example.explanation: The Sun occupies Aries and Scorpio is empty. Keep Aries at three and clear the smaller Scorpio value.

vedic/strength/bhava-bala/components.yam.bhavadhipati: Use the classical sign lord of the madhya. Take its complete six-component Shadbala total in virupas.

birth_time.traditions_differ: CLASSICAL ghatika-based sandhya in Muhurta Chintamani / BPHS 27.31 and Raman, Bhava Bala. Operational civil lower bound is MODERN.
birth_time.window: Use observed apparent upper-limb sunrise/set from the rise-set convention; at standard sea-level conditions the geometric centre is about -0.83°. Twilight extends from -6° to the apparent boundary, exclusive at its upper end.

vedic/strength/bhava-bala/components.yam.bounds: Normalize sidereal longitude modulo 360. Left endpoint included, right endpoint excluded.
vedic/strength/bhava-bala/components.yam.dig: From the strongest reference house count zero at equality. Use the shorter cyclic distance in houses, d, from zero to six. Award 60 minus 10 times d.

drik.sum: CLASSICAL. Jupiter and Mercury each contribute the full positive aspect exactly once irrespective of nature. For each remaining classical graha use one signed quarter (BPHS 27.28–29).

vedic/strength/bhava-bala/components.yam.madhya: Whole-sign MVP. Set the midpoint to the beginning of the house sign plus 15 degrees. Do not shift planets between houses.

midpoint_methods.sripati: CLASSICAL option. Use Ascendant, IC, Descendant and MC as madhyas 1,4,7,10. Trisect each forward quadrant arc for the intervening madhyas. Direction is shortest arc from the class weakest cardinal angle divided by three. Assign occupants between successive sandhis, inclusive at entry. Use the madhya sign for the birth-time term.
midpoint_methods.whole-sign-middle: MODERN. Sign start plus 15 degrees. Direction from shorter whole-house count.

occupants.placement: Whole-sign by default. Sripati uses half-open sandhis halfway between consecutive madhyas. The birth-time award follows the madhya sign.

vedic/strength/bhava-bala/components.yam.source_note: PyJHora 5.0.6 jhora/const.py sign-class ranges and jhora/horoscope/chart/strength.py _bhava_dig_bala reference houses. The whole-sign midpoint and house-count distance are modern MVP choices; the corrected aspect weighting follows the owner-selected classical reading.
vedic/strength/bhava-bala/components.yam.sunrise_binding: Prefer actual apparent upper-limb horizon status from the rise-set solver at the site over the standard sea-level approximation.
vedic/strength/bhava-bala/components.yam.total: Add unrounded lord, direction, drik, occupant and birth-time terms. Classical added terms follow BPHS ch.27 vv.30–31 and Raman Bhava Bala chapter; primary verification pending.
vedic/strength/bhava-bala/components.yam.unknown_if: Unstable rising sign, unknown lord total, aspect, classification or midpoint.

vedic/strength/grade.yaml.basis: Bhava360 practitioner synthesis of classical dignity, house, aspect and avastha considerations. Add the unrounded terms before assigning a band.
grade_variants: Combust exalted dignity retained by default
Retrograde debilitated uplift per Uttara Kalamrita 2.6 is optional
Debilitated vargottama retains D9 dignity and repetition separately

inputs.cancellation: Count distinct physical causes among the true branches of vedic.yogas.neecha-bhanga for the same debilitated D1 graha. An undecided count with multiple possible awards withholds the grade.
inputs.combustion: Use the inclusive speed-specific orbs in vedic/states/combustion-orbs.yaml.
inputs.dignity: Use the resolved KB dignity label for each division, with vedic/dignity/sign-dignities.yaml endpoint precedence and vedic/dignity/relationships.yaml directed compound friendship.
inputs.house: From Lagna, or from the Moon only when Lagna is explicitly withheld. Count the angle/trine overlap once.
inputs.received_aspects: Complete set of distinct full aspects under vedic/aspects/full-graha.yaml. Classify each caster and retrograde target under vedic/planets/benefic-profile.yaml. Nodes cast only the seventh.
inputs.war: Use the resolved planetary-war loser flag.

vedic/strength/grade.yaml.limits: Deduplicate reliefs that describe the same physical contact.
vedic/strength/grade.yaml.paksha_notes: CLASSICAL phase dependence (BPHS chapters 3 and 27, Phaladeepika chapter 2). The symmetric linear signed scale is editorial.

sandhi.distance: smaller arc to nearest sign boundary or selected bhava sandhi
sandhi.effect: Within the window mark the relevant dignity or placement provisional; withhold if the declared interval crosses the boundary. No second numeric penalty.

sources.locator: Chapter 2 verse 6 on dignity and retrogression
Ch.7 cancellation and avastha discussion (locator pending)

traditions_differ: Node dignities vary by school. Neither division assigns dignity points to a node by default.
Multiple independent relief conditions earn +1 by Bhava360 choice. No cancellation award in D9.
The earlier consultation-method section 8.1 composite includes Shadbala. It is a non-default variant; no Shadbala quantity feeds this grade.

vedic/strength/shadbala/components.yaml.aggregate: Compare total to the planet-specific minimum. Withhold a qualitative label until reference arithmetic passes.

approved_public_phrases.en: This planet may lend support to the topics it represents.
approved_public_phrases.hi: इस ग्रह से जुड़े विषयों को सहारा मिल सकता है।
approved_public_phrases.kn: ಈ ಗ್ರಹವು ಸೂಚಿಸುವ ವಿಷಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಬೆಂಬಲ ಸಿಗಬಹುದು.

approved_public_phrases.en: The planet’s placement may help you explore where its themes feel familiar.
approved_public_phrases.hi: ग्रह की स्थिति से आप देख सकते हैं कि उससे जुड़े विषय आपको कहाँ परिचित लगते हैं।
approved_public_phrases.kn: ಗ್ರಹದ ಸ್ಥಾನವು ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ವಿಷಯಗಳು ನಿಮಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಚಿತವಾಗಿವೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಗಮನಿಸಲು ನೆರವಾಗಬಹುದು.

approved_public_phrases.en: You may notice where the planet’s themes find an outlet in daily life.

approved_public_phrases.kn: ಗ್ರಹಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ವಿಷಯಗಳು ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ಬದುಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂದು ಗಮನಿಸಬಹುದು.

approved_public_phrases.en: The timing in your chart may add context to this theme.
approved_public_phrases.hi: आपकी कुंडली में समय से जुड़े संकेत इस विषय को समझने में मदद कर सकते हैं।
approved_public_phrases.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಂಡಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಕಾಲಸೂಚನೆ ಈ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ನೆರವಾಗಬಹುದು.

approved_public_phrases.en: The planet’s motion may add a different emphasis to a familiar theme.
approved_public_phrases.hi: ग्रह की गति से किसी परिचित विषय का दूसरा पहलू उभर सकता है।
approved_public_phrases.kn: ಗ್ರಹದ ಚಲನೆಯಿಂದ ಪರಿಚಿತ ವಿಷಯದ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಅಂಶ ಗಮನಕ್ಕೆ ಬರಬಹುದು.

approved_public_phrases.en: The planet’s traditional character may offer a starting point for reflection.
approved_public_phrases.hi: ग्रह का पारंपरिक स्वभाव मनन का आधार बन सकता है।
approved_public_phrases.kn: ಗ್ರಹದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಸ್ವಭಾವವು ಚಿಂತನೆಗೆ ಆರಂಭದ ಬಿಂದುವಾಗಬಹುದು.

approved_public_phrases.en: Other planets may help explain why this theme feels different in different settings.
approved_public_phrases.hi: दूसरे ग्रह यह समझने में मदद कर सकते हैं कि अलग परिस्थितियों में यह विषय अलग क्यों लगता है।
approved_public_phrases.kn: ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಸಂದರ್ಭಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ವಿಷಯ ವಿಭಿನ್ನವಾಗಿ ಅನಿಸಲು ಕಾರಣವೇನು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಇತರ ಗ್ರಹಗಳು ನೆರವಾಗಬಹುದು.

vedic/tajika/aspects.yaml.geometry: Use the nearest directed aspect ray on the longitude circle. Residual = signed distance from that ray. Test both orientations; sign boundaries do not interrupt contact.
vedic/tajika/aspects.yaml.motion: Residual times relative signed longitude speed: negative applying (faster body closes the gap), positive separating, zero residual exact. Equal speeds away from exact are stationary.
vedic/tajika/aspects.yaml.orb: Inclusive arithmetic mean of the two planetary orbs.
vedic/tajika/aspects.yaml.reception: Mutual domicile reception if each occupies a sign ruled by the other. Record independently; reception alone does not establish perfection.

vedic/tajika/aspects.yaml.transfer: Nakta: a faster intermediary separates from one principal and next applies to the other, before interruption. Yamaya: both principals apply to the same slower collector. Require distinct actors and no direct applying link.

contact_modifiers.dignity: Own or exalted sign supports expression, debilitation qualifies it. Bind the moving body and its transit sign.
contact_modifiers.reentry: Split each retrograde exit and return into distinct windows; attach repeated-contact emphasis without a second vote.
contact_modifiers.station: A speed reversal within one degree of the natal point extends emphasis; editorial orb, shortest angular distance.
contact_modifiers.tara: Inclusive nakshatra distances 1, 10 and 19 are Janma, Anujanma and Trijanma contacts. Mark repetition; no standalone vote.

kb16.delivery: Attach area modifiers only to the bound target topic. Phase names annotate the existing Saturn house reading. Emit a single nodal-axis reading. Display the raw BAV band and kakshya support separately; numerical details are admin/tester-only.
kb16.reference: One sidereal profile per chart. For index 0..11 use 1 + (transit sign - natal reference sign) modulo 12, applying modulo before adding one. Evaluate each body only inside its dated sign window.

vedic/transits/evidence.yaml.modifiers: Evaluate Vedha obstruction under its own planet/house table and bindus from raw BAV on separate evidence chips.

vedic/transits/evidence.yaml.optional_study: Murti nirnaya, Latta and node Vedha as standalone transit readings are deferred.
vedic/transits/evidence.yaml.phase_reading: Use vedic.doshas.sade-sati for the formation and modules/home/month.yaml for the reading and gentle phase wording.

phase_variants.degree_based: Start Saturn at natal Moon longitude minus 45 degrees; split into three successive 30-degree intervals. Sign-based default; withhold if natal Moon crosses a sign boundary and the phase changes. Wording: modules/home/month.yaml.

vedic/transits/evidence.yaml.windows: Solve all sign crossings, including retrograde exits and returns; attach start/end instants to each continuous phase.

vedic/transits/qualifiers.yaml.binding: Bind one target and one reference. Moon stance, vedha and Saturn phases apply only to Moon. BAV requires a stable Lagna; node BAV has no row. Missing facts are unknown. Support and challenge are separate chips. Forward Vedha is unblocked by convention on the node Moon rows because nodes have no forward pairs. Traditional BAV rows require their own availability; non-applicable factors do not vote.

vedic/transits/vedha.yaml.bounds: Same instant in overlapping start-inclusive, end-exclusive transit windows. Unknown occupancy stays unknown unless an eligible blocker is already known.
vedic/transits/vedha.yaml.exception: Remove each exempt occupant before deciding whether another occupant still obstructs.
vedic/transits/vedha.yaml.meaning: Pair each supportive relative house with a possible obstructing relative house measured from natal Moon. Inspect other transiting occupants; preserve the named Vedha pair as evidence.

reverse_variant.label: Vipareeta vedha
reverse_variant.method: Invert each favourable-to-obstruction pair for the same graha. An eligible occupant of the corresponding favourable place can relieve the adverse place. Preserve mutual exemptions.
reverse_variant.source: Prasna Marga ch.22 v.35; locator pending.

vedic/transits/vedha.yaml.scope: Seven-graha profile. The source supplies no independent node rows. A listed supportive house is a candidate before obstruction. Read only in the forward direction.

vedic/upagrahas/points.yaml.saturn_points: Divide sunrise-to-sunset or sunset-to-next-sunrise into eight equal segments. Seven rulers run in weekday order starting with day lord, or fifth from day lord by night. Last segment unruled. Gulika is ascendant at start of Saturn segment, Mandi at midpoint (labelled midpoint variant). Unknown horizon or Lagna withholds.

vedic/vargas/methods.yaml.interval: For equal divisions use floor(unrounded degrees within sign × N / 30), starting at zero. Step forward by that many signs from the seed. D2, D3, D4 and D30 use their specified mappings.

methods.mapping: Odd signs use Leo then Cancer. Even signs reverse the pair.
methods.name: Hora

methods.mapping: Count the first, fifth and ninth signs from the natal sign.
methods.name: Drekkana

methods.mapping: Count the first, fourth, seventh and tenth signs from the natal sign.
methods.name: Chaturthamsa

methods.mapping: Begin at the natal sign for odd signs and its seventh for even signs.
methods.name: Saptamsa

methods.mapping: Start at the natal sign for movable signs, its ninth for fixed signs and its fifth for dual signs.
methods.name: Navamsa

methods.mapping: Start at the natal sign for odd signs and its ninth for even signs.
methods.name: Dasamsa

methods.mapping: Start at Aries, Leo or Sagittarius for movable, fixed or dual signs respectively.
methods.name: Shodasamsa

methods.mapping: Start at Aries, Sagittarius or Leo for movable, fixed or dual signs respectively.
methods.name: Vimsamsa

methods.mapping: Start at Leo for odd signs and Cancer for even signs.
methods.name: Chaturvimsamsa

methods.mapping: Start at Aries, Cancer, Libra or Capricorn for fire, earth, air or water signs respectively.
methods.name: Nakshatramsa

methods.mapping: Odd signs use half-open degree bands [0,5,10,18,25,30] mapped to Aries, Aquarius, Sagittarius, Gemini, Libra. Even signs use [0,5,12,20,25,30] mapped to Taurus, Virgo, Pisces, Capricorn, Scorpio.
methods.name: Trimsamsa

methods.mapping: Start at Aries for odd signs and Libra for even signs.
methods.name: Khavedamsa

methods.mapping: Start at Aries, Leo or Sagittarius for movable, fixed or dual signs respectively.
methods.name: Akshavedamsa

methods.deity_index: One-based part in odd signs, 61 minus part in even signs.
methods.mapping: BPHS. Add floor(twice the degree within the sign) to the natal sign index, modulo twelve. Count forward for every sign.
methods.name: Shashtyamsa

rule.rule: Start the K.N. Rao implementation at the natal Lagna at birth. Count to the ninth sign inclusively. If it is Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Capricorn, Aquarius or Pisces, step backward through all twelve major signs; otherwise step forward. For duration, use the period sign’s own foot group: count directed steps to its resolved ruler, with zero steps worth twelve years. Add one for exaltation or subtract one for debilitation. Use classical dignity for the seven grahas; leave nodes unadjusted in this profile. Skip a zero duration. Divide a full Maha equally among twelve Antars. Start one sign ahead for Aries, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Aquarius or Pisces and one behind for the others. Continue in that direction and end with the parent.

rule.rule: Normalize the sidereal Moon longitude to [0°,360°). Each of the 27 stars spans 48000 arcseconds. rule.rule: Number the 27 equal lunar mansions from Ashwini = 1. Add three to the natal Moon’s mansion number and take the remainder modulo eight, reading zero as the eighth Yogini. The fraction elapsed is the arc traversed in that mansion divided by 48000 arcseconds. Subtract that fraction of the first lord’s full years from birth to obtain the true start. Advance by the remaining fraction to obtain the end. Repeat the eight periods in sequence. Each parent opens with its own Yogini and divides among all eight by child years / 36.

rule.rule: Sum the six signed components in virupas and divide by sixty for rupas. Compare the unrounded result with the graha minimum using greater-than-or-equal. The ruler of the selected graha’s exaltation sign occupies a kendra from Lagna or Moon. The distinct rulers of the debilitation and exaltation signs occupy mutual kendras. The dispositor casts a full graha aspect on the selected debilitated graha. Under the alternate reading of tunganatha, a classical planet exalted in the occupied sign is angular from Lagna or Moon. The selected graha is debilitated in D1 but occupies its exaltation sign in D9. The ruler of the selected graha’s D9 sign occupies a D1 angle or trine and either Lagna is movable or the Lagna lord occupies a movable navamsha.
